messages:
Maya Patel: Hey folks — seeing SM% spike on prod GPU pool after the 03:30 canary. Where's the single dashboard that has SM%, GPU mem, kvcache hit%, and batch-size distribution? Also thinking we should nudge the kvcache eviction alert threshold; it's noisy. :thinking:
Joel Chen: There's a consolidated panel in Grafana — https://grafana.redwood-infr.internal/d/gpu_ops/gpu-utilization?orgId=1
Joel Chen: Panels: sm_util, gmem_bytes, kvcache_hit_rate, batch_size_hist
Joel Chen: Quick query for SM%: `avg by(instance) (irate(gpu_sm_active_cycles_total[1m]) / irate(gpu_sm_total_cycles[1m]) * 100)`
Anika Rao: For traces (KV cache evictions) check Jaeger span operation `kvcache.evict` — https://jaeger.redwood-infr.internal/search?service=runtime
Anika Rao: If you can paste a sample pod id I can pull the trace and link it here
metrics-bot: Alert: [kvcache_eviction_rate] prod/gpu-pool exceeded threshold on host gpu-prod-12 — rate=0.23 evicts/s (threshold=0.1)
Sree Kumar: I pushed batching tweak in canary (lowered max_batch_wait_ms from 20 -> 12) around 03:10, rolling to small subset. Could be changing distribution.
Maya Patel: thanks — pod id is runtime-gpu-7f5d9c4b8-26xz
Anika Rao: grabbing trace now
Joel Chen: Re: alert tuning — current kvcache_eviction_rate alert was conservative for safety. Can we move threshold to 0.25 for gpu-pool for now and add a 10m window? That should cut noise but catch persistent regressions.
Maya Patel: sounds reasonable. Any objections
Sree Kumar: fine by me, but let's add a short runbook note and page if >0.4 for 15m
Joel Chen: I'll update the alert rule in prometheus/rules/gpu_alerts.yaml and submit a PR
Joel Chen: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/infra/+/2345 (WIP)
deploy-bot: Canary rollout: runtime/serve-batch-config -> 10% -> healthy
Anika Rao: Trace link: https://jaeger.redwood-infr.internal/trace/abcd1234 (kvcache.evict spikes overlayed with batch_size drop)
Maya Patel: ok, Joel + Sree please coordinate alert change + runbook blurb. Ping me when PR is merged. :thumbsup:
Joel Chen: Will do, aiming to open PR by EOD PST
Sree Kumar: I'll add runbook snippet in the same PR
Maya Patel: Thanks — also add the Grafana panel id to the PR description so support can find it quickly
Joel Chen: panel id: 42
Maya Patel: great, resolved for now :white_check_mark:
